blocks.description: Wide view: The town sits in a low basin between the mountains. The mine is on the hillside above it.

blocks.text: The same motions, over and over. About as thrilling as the little town itself.

background.description: A miner finds the cursed ore. The others gather around and cheer.

An ore merchant examines the ore and finds that it is worth a fortune.
The miner looks surprised and delighted.

pages.speaker: merchant
content: My God... I've never seen ore this beautiful! I'd give everything I own for it.

blocks.description: The townspeople mine day and night, hoping to sell more ore for more money.

blocks.text: More digging, more money. Rest, sadly, doesn't pay.

blocks.description: They follow the ore deeper into the mountain. Water starts to seep through the rock, but they keep digging.

background.description:
A pickaxe breaks through the last layer of rock, opening a path to an underground river higher inside the mountain.
The crack widens. Water bursts into the tunnel. The miners drop their tools and run.

pages.speaker: miner-1
content: Wait. Why is so much water leaking through?

background.description:

The crack widens. Water bursts into the tunnel. The miners drop their tools and run.

pages.speaker: miner-2
content: Just a little more. There's got to be more ore behind—

background.description:
A pickaxe breaks through the last layer of rock, opening a path to an underground river higher inside the mountain.
The crack widens. Water bursts into the tunnel. The miners drop their tools and run.

Water rushes through the tunnels, out of the hillside mine entrance, and down toward the town.
The basin's narrow outlet cannot drain the water fast enough. The water rises until the whole town is flooded.
People flee. Some do not escape the flood.

By the present day, the floodwater is long gone. High water marks stain the town walls. Mud and broken buildings fill the streets.
A and B look around in shock. They move forward, exploring the town.
A grips the coin tightly.

pages.speaker: b
content: The water got that high...? Did the people here get out?

content: We don't know yet. Feeling ready to take a look inside? I'll go first.

Description: Contact with the coin creates an intense desire for it. Those affected will do whatever it takes to get more.
